<script>
/*Custom Google Analytics */

 /* PRODUCT LISTING AND SEARCH LISTING  */


/* PRODUCT CLICK FROM PRODUCT CAROUSELS */
addOnLoad(function() {
	var trackProductElement = document.getElementsByClassName('trackCarouselProduct');
	addEventListenerToElements(trackProductElement,"click", function() {
		var parent = findAncestorByClass(this, "item-panel");
		var code = parent.getAttribute("data-code");
		var name = parent.getAttribute("data-name");
		var price = parent.getAttribute("data-price");
		var brand = parent.getAttribute("data-brand");
		var currency = parent.getAttribute("data-currency");
		var category = parent.getAttribute("data-category");
		var position = parent.getAttribute("data-position");
		dataLayer.push({
			'event': 'product_click',
			'ecommerce': {
				'currencyCode': currency,
				'click': {
					'actionField': {
						'list': 'Product Carousel'
					},
					'products': [{
						'name': name,
						'id': code,
						'price': price,
						'brand': brand,
						'category': category,
						'position': position
					}]
				}
			}
		});
	});
});

/* PDP */
  
  
/*ADD TO CART FROM ANYWHERE  */
function trackAddToCart_Customgoogle(productCode, quantityAdded, cartData) {
	dataLayer.push({
		'event': 'add_to_cart',
		'ecommerce': {
			'currencyCode': cartData.productCurrency,  
			'add': {
				'products': [{
	        		'name': cartData.productName,
	        		'id': productCode,
	        		'price': cartData.productPrice,
	        		'brand': cartData.productBrand,
	       	 		'category': cartData.productCategory,
	        		'quantity': quantityAdded
	       		}]
			}
	   }
	});
}  
  
window.mediator.subscribe('trackAddToCart', function(data) {
	if (data.productCode && data.quantity) {
		trackAddToCart_Customgoogle(data.productCode, data.quantity, data.cartData);
	}
});
  
/* CART */
